name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. I followed the vendor's instructions: the OpenAI Python SDK was already installed, I created the quickstart.py script using the exact code pattern from the docs (OpenAI SDK approach), and a chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model. The API responded with: "Hello in Spanish is **Hola**."
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I deviated by querying the available models via the API (/v1/models) and substituting "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2", which is a chat-capable model currently deployed on the platform. After this substitution, the quickstart code worked exactly as documented.
